summary.text: Edmond Laplante, a Constitution Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in New Hampshire to Chris Pappas.

A Marine Corps veteran and longtime automotive mechanic, he lists himself in his Ballotpedia survey response as New Hampshire state chairman of the Constitution Party and a member of the SAU93 (Richmond) school board.

paragraphs.text: Laplante was born in Gardner, Massachusetts. He earned a high school diploma from Montachusett Regional Vocational Tech and graduated from the Ohio Diesel and Gas Technical Institute in 1988.
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1999 to 2007.

In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey response, Laplante describes himself as an auto mechanic for more than 40 years, with a "master tech degree," an associate degree in aviation science and an A&P license.
Ballotpedia notes a past affiliation with the Richmond Swanzey Republican Town Committee.
He received 1.9% of the vote to Chris Pappas' 55.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
